Tomohiro's little sister, and a child star turned successful voice actress.
As the breadwinner of their family, she manages their household finances.

In reality, she's the one who would go crazy if she doesn't pamper Tomohiro, but he's the only one who knows that.
"So Onii is the student council president now?
This imouto always believed that you could succeed if you tried."
From the official website

Special Skill: Sewing
Favorite Food: Takoyaki

The mysterious transfer student who transferred into class at the beginning of the year, and went truant on her second day.
She's actually a world-famous illustrator.
Recently she's been working on art for social games while posting sketches online to maintain her pride.
It seems she's made acquaintance with Tomohiro in the past.
She loves takoyaki. She loves it so much she set it as her profile picture.
"You know, I wasn't even planning on eating until now.
But of course I'll want to eat takoyaki if you tempt me like that!"
From the official website
As an illustrator she's known as Nonoka, who Tomohiro is a huge fan of.
In the gacha game he plays, she illustrates a character who Hiyori voices.
She also illustrated the VTuber Yukige Shiki and they both admire each other's work.
She works on games, anime, manga, eroge, and the like.

転入2日目から不登校になり、その謎に一層深みが増した。
その正体は、世間でも知られた人気イラストレーター。
最近はソシャゲの仕事をしながらSNSに落書きをアップし自尊心を満たしている。
過去に智宏と面識があるらしいが……？
好物はたこ焼き。好き過ぎて自画像がたこ焼き化している。

Special Skill: Massaging
Favorite Food: Steamed Meat Buns
Hobby: Singing
Tomohiro's junior, she met him at a convenience store.
You won't often find her at school.
Like a rare character, her appearances and personality are great, yet it's a mystery as to why she's truant.
Unbeknownst to anyone, she's the face behind the Vtuber Yukigeshiki.
With her singing skills that put pros to shame, her subscriber count is skyrocketing.
Her love for steamed meat buns doesn't fade even in the sweltering summer months.
"I'm not good at dealing with guys,
But I don't sense any obscenity from you, senpai..."
From the official website
智宏がコンビニで出逢った後輩。
ただし、学園ではめったにエンカウントできない。
レアキャラらしく、見た目も性格も稀に見る「いい子」だが、それだけに不登校になった理由は一切分かっていない。
裏では『雪景シキ』という名のVtuberとして活動中。
プロ顔負けの歌唱力が口コミで評判になり、飛ぶ鳥を落とす勢いでチャンネル登録者数を伸ばしている。
肉まんをこよなく愛しており、その愛は夏だろうと薄れることはない。
智宏がコンビニで出逢った後輩VTuber。
一時期智宏から本気で天使だと思われていた。
配信活動の中心を歌に据えているとおり、音楽については抜群の才能を持つ。
周りの人がどれだけ言っても、自分のやりたいことはあまり曲げてくれない。
実は生徒会で一番芯があるのかも。
智宏在便利店偶遇到的后辈。
然而，在学校几乎无法遇到。
外表和性格都是非常稀有的“好孩子”角色，
正因如此，对她不上学的理由一无所知。
正在以雪景四季的名字，开展Vtuber活动。
不输给专业人士歌喉的口碑，
使她的的频道订阅数飞速增长。
深爱肉包，哪怕盛夏都不会使她的爱变质。

Favorite Food: Noodles, Local Specialties when Travelling

The former student council president, she's the cause of Tomohiro's problems.
When she was student council president, her charisma earned her fans even in other schools, let alone their own.
But she has a twisted personality, having fired all the other council members.
In her eyes, the student council presidency was just one of the life experiences that she draws upon to use in her works as a professional novelist.
She's annoyed that people make history jokes about her surname Kamakura, but she keeps that a secret.
"The pitch accent is wrong. It's not shi-o (→ ↑, salt), it's Shi-o (↑ ↑).
Although it's true that my way of doing things makes some people salty..."

A popular model in fashion magazines. She's often featured on magazine covers, and recently was invited to a fashion show.
She was at the top of the school pecking order, but recently she's been too busy to meet with her friends.
A savvy and experienced social media user, she doesn't seem to complement Tomohiro at all. Yet for some reason, she's been hanging out with the student council lately.
